artist.name: Markus Naarttijärvi
artist.bio: Markus Naarttijärvi is a documentary photographer based in Umeå, Sweden. His long-term projects follow industry, nature and culture in northern Sweden, exploring solitude, perseverance and the passage of time.

status: Unpublished preview. Titles, descriptions, paper formats, borders and proofs await Mark and Markus's confirmation.

prints.title: Through the Willows
prints.description: A river glows gold beneath a screen of willow and oak leaves, with a single bird cutting across the haze. Soft, warm light and a quiet, waiting stillness.

prints.title: Pines Under Starlight
prints.description: Snow-laden pines stand still beneath a clear, star-scattered sky. A hushed, cold-clear winter night, lit by nothing but the moon.

prints.title: Winter Yard, Night
prints.description: A lit window and a lone streetlamp cut through a dark, snow-heavy night in a quiet yard. Falling snow catches the light; everything else stays in shadow.

prints.title: Current and Foam
prints.description: Pale ridges of ice or foam swirl across dark water, closer to a painting than a photograph. An abstract, almost weightless study in movement and cold.

prints.title: The Road at Sunset
prints.description: Three cyclists ride a curving road into low evening sun, forest and hills fading into the haze beyond. A warm, quiet end to the day, caught mid-journey.

prints.title: Sun Over the Forest
prints.description: A huge, hazy sun hangs low over a dark line of trees, the sky burning orange around it. Simple, elemental, and quietly dramatic.

prints.title: Swan on Still Water
prints.description: A lone swan drifts across a misty lake at first light, reeds standing dark in the foreground. Calm, hushed, and completely still.

prints.title: Morning, Cabin Room
prints.description: Soft light falls through lace curtains onto a simple bed, with greenery pressing close against the window. A quiet, unmade corner of a wooden cabin.

prints.title: Path Through the Trees
prints.description: A wooden boardwalk winds through dense, shadowed forest towards a bright clearing ahead. The kind of path that pulls you on to see what's next.

prints.title: Sheep on the Track
prints.description: A small flock of dark sheep stands watching on a muddy track between hedgerows, a green pasture opening beyond them. Damp, overcast, and entirely rural.
